crossRefs.note: When Elisha had come into the house, behold, the child was dead, and lying on his bed.
Peter sent them all out, and knelt down and prayed. Turning to the body, he said, “Tabitha, get up!” She opened her…
He gave her his hand, and raised her up. Calling the saints and widows, he presented her alive.
He came and took her by the hand, and raised her up. The fever left her immediately, and she served them.
Taking the child by the hand, he said to her, “Talitha cumi!” which means, being interpreted, “Girl, I tell you, get…
He took hold of the blind man by the hand, and brought him out of the village. When he had spat on his eyes, and laid…
But Jesus took him by the hand, and raised him up; and he arose.
But he put them all outside, and taking her by the hand, he called, saying, “Child, arise!”

translations.web: But when the crowd was put out, he entered in, took her by the hand, and the girl arose.
translations.bsb: After the crowd had been put outside, Jesus went in and took the girl by the hand, and she got up.
translations.kjv: But when the people were put forth, he went in, and took her by the hand, and the maid arose.
translations.asv: But when the crowd was put forth, he entered in, and took her by the hand; and the damsel arose.
